negativeCheckNThreads0.result: PASS: driver-reported exit 1 (its-ca-tracker child device itself exited 128/SIGABRT via LOGP(fatal)); expected fatal message present in run.log; o2trac_its_ca.root DOES exist (created by the its-ca-track-writer device's ordinary startup, independent of tracker success) but its 'o2sim' TTree has 0 entries -- confirmed no track data was ever written
negativeCheckNThreads0.structuralDifferenceFromSlice3NegativeCh: gate3-slice3-its-ca-validation/negative_checks_its_common_ca.sh's two cases fire inside ConfigPreflight at defineDataProcessing()-time, before any device is constructed at all (confirmed there: no output file appears). This nThreads<=0 check instead lives in ITSMFTTrackingInterface::initialiseTracker(), only reached from the tracker device's first real run() call (source-confirmed via CATrackerSpec.cxx:184-189 before writing this check) -- so devices, including the writer, ARE constructed and started first. This is why this script's 'no usable output' assertion checks tree-entry-count==0 rather than file-non-existence.
